title: Take-up Rate of Capability Transfer Programme and Its Effectiveness in Helping Singaporean Workers Acquire New Capabilities
what_it_is: Take-up Rate of Capability Transfer Programme and Its Effectiveness in Helping Singaporean Workers Acquire New Capabilities

sections.label: CTP companies and locals benefited
sections.summary: Since October 2017, over 140 companies and more than 990 locals across over 20 sectors have benefited or are expected to benefit from the CTP.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Since the CTP was introduced in October 2017, more than 140 companies and over 990 locals across more than 20 sectors have benefited or are expected to benefit from the programme.

sections.label: Foreign workforce reduction suggestion rejected
sections.summary: The suggestion to require companies to reduce their foreign workforce after completing a CTP project is considered too blunt an approach.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As to the suggestion to require that the company reduces its foreign workforce after completing a CTP project, I think it is too blunt an approach.

sections.label: CTP extended to September 2024
sections.summary: With gradual resumption of international travel, more enquiries and applications are expected for the CTP, which has been extended to September 2024.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: With the gradual resumption of international travel, we expect more enquiries and applications for the CTP, which has been extended to September 2024.

sections.label: Resident employment and PMET share
sections.summary: Resident employment has grown strongly over 10 years, with PMET jobs now 62.1% of resident workers versus 52.7% in 2011.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Resident employment has grown strongly over the past 10 years, driven by PMET jobs which now make up 62.1% of resident workers, compared to 52.7% in 2011.

sections.label: CTP funding and co-funding ratio
sections.summary: CTP projects can receive up to 90% funding, with the co-funding ratio depending on project impact and whether the applicant is an SME or non-SME.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Today, CTP projects can receive up to 90% funding and the co-funding ratio will depend on the impact of the CTP project, and whether, of course, the entity that is applying is an SME or non-SME, or organising the programme on an industry-wide level.

sections.label: No feedback on CTP funding limits
sections.summary: WSG has received no feedback from interested companies that existing support rates or the S$300,000 project funding cap are restrictive.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: But I think let me set the perspective.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Thus far, since the programme began till now, WSG has not received any feedback from interested companies that the existing support rates or the project funding cap of S$300,000 is restrictive.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: It is something that we have started for quite a number of years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Certainly, companies have benefited and, like I said, 990 locals, close to about 1,000, have also benefited or will be benefiting from the programme.

sections.label: Funding details for companies
sections.summary: The speaker does not have current numbers on funding of up to 90% for 140 companies and 990 locals, but will provide details later.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As far as the numbers in terms of the 140 companies and the 990 locals are concerned, how much of the funding of up to 90% we have been able to accord, at this particular point in time, I do not have the numbers, but I am happy to provide the details subsequently.
